body.description: Barbwyre: a spool of barbed wire come alive, a wooden reel body with rusty barbed wire wrapped around it, loose coils of wire lashing out like tentacles, glinting barbs, two eyes peering between the coils. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
